title: MARS hydrophone annotation file
description: Structure of the labels_<month>_<class>.json files in this directory. Each file holds every expert-confirmed annotation of one class in one month of MBARI MARS hydrophone recordings. One annotation is one 5-second window. Field semantics, label definitions, and taxonomy are documented in docs/annotation_schema.md; the release as a whole is described in docs/DATA.md.

month.description: The month this file covers. Matches the month field of every annotation in it.

species.description: The label class this file covers. Matches the species field of every annotation in it. Named 'species' for historical reasons; ship_noise and other are not taxa.

count.description: Number of entries in annotations. Equals n_positive + n_negative.

n_positive.description: Entries with label_type 'positive' — the class was confirmed present.

n_negative.description: Entries with label_type 'negative' — weak negatives, used as training signal only. Present only for orca_call in April 2018 (54).

n_recordings.description: Number of distinct source recordings the annotations are drawn from.

oneOf.title: Killer whale vocalization
oneOf.description: Orcinus orca. In this archive predominantly the Bigg's (transient) ecotype; no ecotype classification is provided by the released models.

oneOf.title: Humpback whale vocalization
oneOf.description: Megaptera novaeangliae. The name is broader than it sounds: this class covers humpback vocalization generally, including non-song social calls.

oneOf.title: Delphinid vocalization other than killer whale
oneOf.description: Family Delphinidae; species not resolved. Clicks, whistles and burst-pulse sounds.

oneOf.title: Vessel noise
oneOf.description: Anthropogenic: propulsion, cavitation, broadband mechanical noise. Not a taxon.

oneOf.title: Unclassified real signal
oneOf.description: A detectable signal fitting none of the named classes. Not silence: quiet background is a weak negative and never appears as a positive. Not a taxon.

recording_32khz.description: Bare filename of the 32 kHz resampled recording — no path. Derived from the public raw file MARS_<YYYYMMDD>_<HHMMSS>.wav by resampling/resample_sox_32k.sh. The timestamp is the recording start in UTC.

annotation_offset_s.description: Start of the 5-second window, in seconds from the beginning of the recording. Windows are non-overlapping, so offsets are multiples of 5. The window spans [offset, offset+5).

frame_index.description: annotation_offset_s / 5. Redundant with the offset; provided for convenience when indexing embedding arrays.

recording_start_utc_epoch.description: Unix epoch seconds of the recording start, parsed from the filename timestamp. Add annotation_offset_s for the window's own UTC time. Null if the filename could not be parsed.

label.description: 1 for a positive annotation, 0 for a weak negative. Redundant with label_type.

oneOf.description: The class was confirmed present in this window by expert listening.
Weak negative: confirmed NOT to contain the class. Training signal only; never a detection.

annotator.description: Who made the annotation. Every annotation in this release is 'duane' (D. Edgington); humpback labels were verified by J. P. Ryan. Set by the exporter rather than read from the database — see docs/DATA.md for why.
